validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION CONFIRMED, independent of GEM. This is a real, FERC-authorized compressor-station uprate on Florida Gas Transmission Company, LLC's (FGT) interstate transmission system, docket CP23-492-000: FGT filed the NGA Sec. 7(c) certificate application on 2023-06-02 (confirmed verbatim by the Federal Register notice at federalregister.gov/documents/2023/08/16/2023-17612, which names the docket and 'South Louisiana Project' by name) and FERC authorized construction in an order issued April 2024 (per web search of ferc.gov meeting summaries; the order PDF itself 403s to scripted fetches -- ferc.gov's root and /news-events/ paths are Cloudflare-gated, consistent with this batch's MEASURED CONDITIONS note). Independently, EIP's Oil & Gas Watch nonprofit database (oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/6491, id 6491) carries a detailed record for 'South Louisiana Project' matching FGT/CP23-492: same project description (uprate CS7.5 St. Landry Parish LA, add cooling at CS8 East Baton Rouge LA, new unit at CS9 Washington Parish LA, new unit at CS10 Perry County MS), AdditionalCapacity 96.5 MMscf/d, OperatingStatus 'Operating', last QAQC'd 2025-12-17. The two sources are independent origins (FERC/Federal Register vs. EIP, an environmental-advocacy nonprofit unaffiliated with FERC or FGT) and agree. NOTE ON THE REF: oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/6491 is a JS single-page app -- curl/url_verifier only sees an empty shell, which is why the worklist's existing_ref_checks show 'value not found' / 'name not found' on every HAS_REF unit citing it. The page's own client-side code calls a public JSON endpoint (https://oilandgaswatch.org/api/01-01_PIPELINES/data/6491) to render itself; I fetched that endpoint directly and it returns the full record verbatim (pipeline_name, capacity, cost, dates, status, states all present as plain JSON). I am treating the human page as correctly cited (hand-confirmed per the verifier's own script-block caveat) rather than dropping a ref that a JS-blind check couldn't read. CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas both confirmed -- FGT is an NGA-certificated interstate gas transmission system; this project only adds compression capacity (no new pipe: EIP Miles=0, PipelineDiameterinches=null), which is why GEM correctly carries LengthKnown=0/Diameter blank for this row (P5548 is one of the ten LengthKnown=0 compression-scope rows the orchestrator already flagged -- confirmed, not a defect). DUPLICATE CHECK: not the same project as the EIA-tracked 'South Central Louisiana' expansion (docket CP25-30, $43.4M, 75 MMcf/d, in-service 2027, still in Construction as of the Aug-2026 EIA release) that this row's prompt pre-matched from the EIA workbook -- that is a SEPARATE, later FGT compressor project, filed 2025-01, per a second Federal Register search (federalregister.gov/documents/2025/01/07/2025-00090 and 2025/02/06/2025-02279) and per this batch's own duplicate note that P7824 'FGT South Central Louisiana' (proposed, batch A1) is a different project with a similar name -- P7824 is that EIA row, not this one. See cross_row_leads. Also not the same as sibling P4059 (FGT Mobile County Project, Alabama) -- different docket/scope.
